units: <cite ref="Beitzah 16a:15">Bets. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>מידי דמְלַפֵּת בעינן</he> (Alf. <he>דמִילַּפֵּת</he>) something used as a relish is required, <he>ופת לא מְלַפְּתָא</he> (Ms. M. <he>מילפת</he>, Alf. <he>מִילַּפְּתָא</he>) whereas bread is not used for that purpose.

senses.gloss: to be used as לִפְתָּא; v. supra.
